name: Wanted Dead or a Wild

features.name: VS symbols
features.description: In the base game and Duel at Dawn bonus, VS symbols expand into a full-reel wild with a multiplier up to 100x.

features.name: Great Train Robbery
features.description: Free spins with sticky multiplier wilds.

features.name: Dead Man's Hand
features.description: Sticky wilds where multipliers reset each spin, combined with Duel at Dawn.

review: Wanted Dead or a Wild is the game that made Hacksaw a household name with high-volatility players. Three separate bonuses, each purchasable on its own where bonus buys are allowed, give the game far more variety than a single free spins round. The Duel at Dawn feature – expanding VS reels with multipliers – can produce huge results on just a few spins, which is why it is popular with streamers. It is very swingy; most bonuses pay modestly and a few pay enormously.
author: editorial-team
